surface_name: OpenAI organization and project spend limits
title: With no hard spend limit on your OpenAI organization or project, a traffic spike or leaked key is billed in full
symptoms: Spend alert emails arrive but API traffic keeps running
The month's usage is far above what you planned, with no requests ever refused
cause: Spend alerts only send a notification and do not enforce a cap. Traffic stops at a set amount only when a hard spend limit is enforced on the organization or the project. Without one, usage runs up to the organization's approved usage limit, which OpenAI raises automatically as usage grows.
fix: Set a monthly spend limit with Enforce a hard limit turned on, for the organization and for the project your app's key belongs to, and keep spend alerts below it as early warnings. When a limit is hit, requests fail with 429 and the code organization_spend_limit_exceeded or project_spend_limit_exceeded, so show users a clear message. Enforcement is not instant, so recorded spend can slightly pass the limit.
affected: OpenAI API organizations and projects without an enforced hard spend limit
